arcs.title: The Second Circle
arcs.summary: Day 4: The table has reached terminal readiness — chart, trail guide, recovery rope, annotated access-road notes, and hand-winch, all present. Departure is confirmed for Saturday at first light. Steve has folded over the corner of the chart containing the precise time. Christine has the road in both directions. The Jellico source's duck remains on the mirror, facing north-northeast; Steve calls it the compass. The Ministry has requested its removal in triplicate; no one has complied. Day 5 — the final day — is Friday, the eve of departure: the table should be photographed in the paper as a record, the Jeep given a final inspection, and the duck consulted one last time. Resolution should feel like the held breath before the wheels turn — everything ready, everyone knowing, first light almost here.
